name: Marcus T.
text: Been doing box jumps 2x a week with my squat training and my vertical is up 3 inches. The key is really the recovery piece - I was burning out until I cut the volume in half.

name: Sarah K.
text: Great article but I'm still confused about the programming. Should plyos come before or after heavy lifting in the session? Currently doing them after and feeling pretty fatigued.

name: James R.
text: This is spot on. Too many lifters I see in the gym jump into plyos without building the foundational strength first. You need a solid base or you're just asking for injury.

name: Devon L.
text: Tried the med ball throws with my deadlift block last month. Loved the power transfer but my shoulder started tweaking. Anyone else have shoulder issues with explosive work?

name: Patricia M.
text: Finally something that explains why I was getting so beat up. The distinction between power endurance and maximal power training was really helpful for programming my clients.
